approved_premise.override_reason: For the first Episode, establish the protagonist's cartographer role, mentor relationship, world navigation logic, and the first Main Saga anomaly. The Luna-selected fisher premise remains a strong later world-side candidate but gives a 12-year-old apprentice too much community route-safety responsibility too early.

premise.title: The Angle That Wouldn't Match
premise.logline: A routine beacon calibration turns into Deniz's first real test of whether patient observation can outweigh a mentor's doubt.
premise.protagonist_role: Apprentice surveyor conducting supervised but semi-independent beacon calibration checks.
premise.immediate_objective: Confirm whether a magnetic-stone beacon reading at Beacon Ridge is a genuine anomaly or an instrument error before the calibration window closes.
premise.inciting_event: While logging a routine reading, Deniz notices the beacon's angle has drifted further than tide tables allow, but the harbor's shipping logs show no confirming delays or complaints that would prove the drift is real.
premise.central_problem: Deniz has only a single suspicious reading and a narrow window before the tide changes and the anomaly becomes unmeasurable again, with no corroborating evidence yet and a mentor likely to dismiss a lone data point.
premise.wonder_or_discovery: A pattern emerges suggesting the drift is tied to tidal extremes rather than random error, hinting at something systematic in the old navigation network.
premise.stakes: If dismissed as a measurement mistake, a real anomaly worth investigating could go unrecorded for another season; if reported too early on thin evidence, Deniz risks being seen as overconfident and losing supervised field privileges.
constraints: Limited daylight and tide window at Beacon Ridge
Only supervised access to the beacon instruments
Mentor evaluates methodology, not just conclusions
premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Deniz must decide whether to report the single unusual reading now, risking dismissal for insufficient evidence, or spend the remaining tide window trying to capture a second corroborating reading, risking losing the anomaly's window entirely if it doesn't recur.
premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Is this drift an isolated fluke, or the first visible sign of a larger disagreement between the old markers and the official charts?
premise.local_payoff: Deniz secures at least a provisional, logged acknowledgment of the anomaly, changing how the mentor treats future field reports.
persistent_outcomes_possible: Mentor's assessment of Deniz's methodology shifts (skeptical, cautious-respect, or dismissive)
A dated logbook entry becomes a reusable reference item
A rumor begins circulating among harbor navigators about 'the ridge beacon problem'
world_specific_elements: harbor shipping logs as corroborating evidence

dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core story problem should feel substantively suitable for a 12-year-old, not like preschool play dressed in harder vocabulary.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, and multi-step progression while remaining readable.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, evidence, competing explanations, responsibility, trust, and consequences without requiring adult-only abstraction.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should follow from multiple linked causes rather than one-step problem-solution patterns.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Reader should sometimes connect clues, motives, patterns, or consequences without every relationship being stated directly.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Character should face meaningful options, trade-offs, strategy, or uncertainty; choices must not be predetermined.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Actions should matter to reputation, relationships, access, goals, safety, or world state without requiring graphic danger.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support trust, disagreement, rivalry, mentorship, competing interests, and mixed motives without adult melodrama.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat resolutions; allow wrong hypotheses, reversals, incomplete information, and earned payoff.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented episodes should offer places, systems, discoveries, mysteries, or experiences larger than ordinary daily-life simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language suitable for an independent 12-year-old reader. Story maturity must not depend on jargon.

required_story_capabilities: Meaningful protagonist role in the world
At least one non-trivial objective or unresolved question
Meaningful discovery or change in understanding
A real choice, strategic constraint, or consequential action
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value
Adventure-oriented modes should include wonder, exploration, mystery, or extraordinary experience
reject_signals: Core premise is primarily pretend-play with toys, chores, or ordinary-room simulation unless explicitly requested
Difficult vocabulary is doing the work of making an otherwise young-child premise appear older
Problem resolves through one obvious attempt with no meaningful complication
Character mostly observes while adults or the world solve the important problem
Episode can be summarized as collect clue A, clue B, clue C with no reasoning change
Stakes are cosmetic and no persistent consequence can result
Mystery is solved before the character earns the relevant evidence
World can be swapped for any generic setting without changing the premise materially
language_rules: Technical terms are allowed when they serve the world or reasoning and can be understood in context
Do not infantilize dialogue or narration
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise maturity
Keep exposition bounded and reveal information through action, observation, dialogue, or consequence where practical
safety_rules: Adventure tension is allowed without requiring graphic violence
Fear, danger, loss, rivalry, and uncertainty may be present when developmentally appropriate
Do not assume maturity requires darker or more violent content
Do not force romance, grief, betrayal, or trauma merely to make a story feel older
calibration_notes: A strong age-12 premise may involve systems failing, competing hypotheses, expedition planning, social disagreement, hidden history, evidence testing, or strategic risk.
A simple premise may still pass when deliberately selected for a calm/intimate mode, but should not be used as the default adventure ceiling.
Evaluate premise, narrative, conceptual, interest, and language maturity independently.

character.name: Deniz
character.origin_summary: Deniz grew up in Meridian Harbor apprenticing under a demanding mapmaker, driven to prove that patient observation can reveal what official charts miss.
character.current_role: apprentice cartographer under supervised but increasingly independent fieldwork

identity_anchors.statement: Deniz believes careful observation matters more than authority or bravado.
Deniz wants recognition earned through proof, not granted by rank.

core_drives.drive: Prove that rigorous observation reveals truths official maps miss.
Earn the right to chart beyond the home strait.

internal_tensions.side_b: pull toward reckless pursuit of a personally meaningful mystery
internal_tensions.description: Deniz's discipline is tested whenever a discovery brushes close to personal stakes.

immediate_desires: earn the right to chart beyond the home strait
find hard evidence others cannot dismiss
immediate_avoidances: being dismissed as a reckless or overconfident child surveyor

world.era: age of sail with precision mechanical navigation
world.habitat: a vast island chain divided by deep channels, storm belts and partially mapped outer seas
world.technology_level: sailing ships, mechanical clocks, optical instruments, printing presses and hand-built navigation devices
world.magic_level: rare, rule-bound geophysical phenomena associated with tides, magnetic stone and ancient infrastructure; no arbitrary spellcasting
world.summary: The Shattered Meridian is an archipelago civilization whose survival depends on maps. Most inner routes are well known, but outer charts disagree, old observatories stand on remote islands, drowned roads appear at extreme tides, and some navigation markers predate every living culture. The world rewards exploration, evidence and careful inference rather than effortless magic.
social_context: cartographers and navigators hold respected public roles
island councils depend on reliable sea routes
young apprentices may take meaningful expedition roles within established safety rules
merchant captains, fishers and scholars often disagree about what counts as trustworthy evidence
old folklore sometimes preserves real geographic information in distorted form
known_pressures: several navigation beacons no longer agree with official charts
outer-island routes are becoming economically important
storm season will eventually restrict long voyages
different groups have reasons to prefer different versions of the map
known_world_facts: Meridian Harbor is Deniz's home port and training base.
Beacon Ridge is part of the known inner navigation network.
The Drowned Causeway is known to appear only during rare low tides.
The Outer Mist Line marks the edge of reliable official charts.
An abandoned tide observatory exists on a distant mapped island.
Several beacon readings have recently become difficult to reconcile with official charts, but no accepted explanation exists yet.

main_saga_public.title: The Uncharted Disagreement
main_saga_public.goal: Discover why the Shattered Meridian's ancient navigation infrastructure and living tides no longer agree with official charts.
main_saga_public.stakes: Outer routes vital to island trade may become unsafe or unusable if the true cause of the discrepancies goes unaddressed.
main_saga_public.central_mystery: Something in the deep channels or the ancient beacon-markers is behaving in ways no known chart-making era can explain.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: Deniz notices a beacon reading that disagrees with the official chart by a margin too large for instrument error.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: Deniz has one documented anomaly and a working hypothesis that it is not simple mistake.
consequence_options: The friend becomes curious and offers to help verify.

active_side_sagas.premise: Deniz's practical-minded friend may want to pursue independent proof through experiments rather than surveying, creating friendly rivalry.
active_side_sagas.why_it_matters: Provides low-stakes roleplay and callback material outside the Main Saga.

creation_constraints: New entities must fit low-magic, rule-bound tidal/magnetic world logic.
New NPCs should have plausible reasons to intersect Deniz's apprentice life.
Do not contradict established hidden truths.

architect_raw_payload.title: The Angle That Wouldn't Match
architect_raw_payload.story_promise: Deniz turns one suspicious beacon reading into a disciplined test, then must choose between a bounded report now and a stronger fresh-setup retest that may cost the record.
architect_raw_payload.protagonist_role: Apprentice surveyor conducting supervised but semi-independent beacon calibration checks.
architect_raw_payload.immediate_objective: Decide whether the Beacon Ridge drift is a genuine anomaly or instrument error before the tide window closes.
architect_raw_payload.central_question: Can careful, auditable observation persuade Kural that the drift is more than a setup mistake?
architect_raw_payload.stakes: A real anomaly may go unrecorded for a season, or Deniz may look overconfident and lose supervised field privileges.
constraints: Limited daylight and tide window at Beacon Ridge
Only supervised access to the beacon instruments
Kural evaluates methodology, not just conclusions
Harbor records are copied-record context only; no travel to Meridian Harbor
architect_raw_payload.opening_hook: Deniz logs a routine reading and sees the beacon angle sitting further off than the tide table allows.

logistics_plan.time_window: About two and a half hours of usable daylight, spanning a falling tide through slack water to the first turning flow, with the gauge checked at each reading.
movement_constraints: All scenes occur at Beacon Ridge.
Meridian Harbor appears only through copied shipping-log pages already in Deniz's field satchel.
Movement is limited to the beacon platform, the tide gauge post, and the second sighting stake on the ridge, a few minutes' walk away.
The instrument may be used only under Kural's supervision.
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: No travel occurs. The five-reading series uses fixed intervals inside the window. The fresh setup and the report each fit in the time left afterward, but not both.

beats.character_action: Deniz logs a routine reading and compares it to the tide table.
beats.external_event: The magnetic-stone beacon sits well past the tabulated tolerance for the current tide.
beats.new_information: The reading exceeds the tide-table allowance.
beats.escalation_delta: The tide clock starts.
beats.state_change: Deniz holds one suspicious data point.
beats.payoff_contribution: Creates the discrepancy to be logged.

beats.purpose: Set the supervision and time constraints.
beats.character_action: Deniz tells Kural only that the reading is odd, and Kural sets conditions for the work.
beats.external_event: Kural says a lone reading is noise until the method is clean, and that the instrument stays supervised.
beats.new_information: Kural judges methodology first; the window closes at the turning tide.
beats.escalation_delta: Access and time are now constrained.
beats.state_change: Deniz must earn credibility through method.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets what Kural will need to see.

beats.character_action: Deniz checks the copied harbor shipping-log pages in the satchel.
beats.external_event: The pages show no delays or complaints for this stretch.
beats.new_information: Nothing external supports the drift.
beats.escalation_delta: The problem shifts from proving the drift to ruling out error.
beats.state_change: Deniz's easiest evidence is gone.
beats.payoff_contribution: Forces an internal test of the instrument.

beats.purpose: Test the first explanation, instrument error.
beats.character_action: Deniz re-levels the instrument, checks the plumb and clamps, and repeats the sighting.
beats.external_event: The offset persists after re-leveling.
beats.new_information: Simple leveling error is unlikely, but the setup could still be at fault.
beats.escalation_delta: The first explanation stops fitting.
beats.state_change: A fixed, re-leveled setup now exists.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives a clean baseline for the series.

beats.character_action: With the setup untouched, Deniz takes exactly five timestamped readings at fixed 20-minute intervals, each paired with a tide-gauge reading.
beats.external_event: The tide falls through slack and begins to turn during the series.
beats.new_information: Offsets on the falling tide: reading 1 is largest, reading 2 slightly smaller, reading 3 near slack is smallest; readings 4 and 5 grow again as the tide turns.
beats.escalation_delta: The pattern changes the question from noise to tide-linked behavior.
beats.state_change: Deniz holds five paired readings on one unchanged setup.
beats.payoff_contribution: Supplies the evidence the reversal uses.

beats.character_action: Deniz plots the five pairs and states what the data does and does not show.
beats.external_event: The plot shows a smooth dip-and-rise, not scatter.
beats.new_information: Within this session, the offset tracks tide state on this one setup.
beats.escalation_delta: An easy dismissal as random error becomes unsafe.
beats.state_change: Deniz has a working hypothesis, with setup-dependence unresolved.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the discrepancy worth logging.

beats.character_action: Deniz weighs a bounded report now against a fresh-setup retest.
beats.external_event: Kural notes the remaining light and tide leave time for one of the two, not both.
beats.new_information: Setup-dependence is the main remaining alternative explanation.
beats.escalation_delta: Time forces an irreversible trade.
beats.state_change: The choice is open.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets the branch-specific outcome.

beats.purpose: Dramatize the chosen branch using earlier evidence.
beats.character_action: Deniz executes the chosen branch using the five-reading table and the stated limits.
beats.external_event: Fixed by branch: report_now leads Kural to accept a provisional entry; fresh_setup_retest reproduces a similar offset but the tide closes before review.
beats.new_information: See decision_point branch results.
beats.escalation_delta: The final test or presentation lands under time pressure.
beats.state_change: The branch result is fixed.
beats.payoff_contribution: Resolves the local uncertainty.

beats.character_action: Deniz finalizes the logbook page or the field note.
beats.external_event: Kural responds according to the branch.
beats.new_information: The durable record either exists (report_now) or does not yet (retest).
beats.escalation_delta: Pressure releases.
beats.state_change: Kural's view of Deniz's method shifts.
beats.payoff_contribution: Delivers the local resolution.

beats.purpose: Open the Saga question without erasing the payoff.
beats.character_action: Deniz looks at other ridge markers and thinks of the harbor logs.
beats.external_event: A distant beacon glints in the dusk.
beats.new_information: No evidence exists about recurrence, cause, or other beacons.
beats.escalation_delta: The question widens from this beacon to the network.
beats.state_change: A forward question opens.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets up the next episode.

escalation_ladder: Simple leveling error is ruled out after re-leveling.
Harbor logs offer no corroboration, so Deniz must generate the evidence.
The five-reading series shows a tide-linked pattern, making random noise an unsafe dismissal.
Time allows only one of report or fresh-setup retest, and setup-dependence remains open.

reversal.prior_belief: The drift is a lone reading, probably instrument error or noise.

evidence.claim: The offset persisted after re-leveling and clamp checks.
Harbor shipping-log copies show no delays or complaints.
Five timestamped readings at fixed 20-minute intervals, each paired with a tide-gauge reading, showed the offset shrinking toward slack and growing again as the tide turned.
On this unchanged setup, the offset varies with tide state during this session.

reversal.reinterpretation: The drift behaves as a tide-linked pattern within one session rather than as scatter, so it warrants logging.
reversal.inference_ceiling: This supports only a within-session correlation on one setup. It does not establish recurrence, physical cause, other beacons, or setup-independence.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Setup-dependence, recurrence on other days, physical cause, other beacons, and any wider Saga mechanism.

decision_point.pressure: The remaining window fits either the bounded report or a fresh-setup retest, not both.

branches.option: Report the five-reading series now with explicit single-setup limits.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz presents the table, the re-leveling record, and the stated limits to Kural.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Strong within-session evidence on a single setup; setup-independence untested.
branches.cost_or_risk: Forgoes the retest, so the entry stays provisional and the alternative explanation stays open.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Kural gains cautious respect for Deniz's methodology and supervised access continues.
branches.climax_requirement: Deniz must defend the method honestly, stating what the series does not show, and answer Kural's setup-dependence challenge without overclaiming.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Kural accepts a provisional dated discrepancy entry with explicit single-setup limits; the logbook page becomes a reusable reference.

branches.option: Use the remaining window for a fresh-setup retest at the second sighting stake.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz re-sets the instrument from scratch and takes a new reading against the tide gauge.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: The fresh setup reproduces a similar offset, strengthening the setup-independent case.
branches.cost_or_risk: The tide closes before Kural can review a formal entry, so no reviewed log is completed.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Kural is impressed by the rigor but cannot log it; access continues with a request to bring the field note next session.
branches.climax_requirement: Deniz must complete the fresh setup and reading under time pressure, then accept that the window has closed with only a timestamped field note.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: The setup-dependence question is resolved in favor of a real offset, but only Deniz's timestamped field note exists, with no milestone commit.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Which trade Deniz will choose: a provisional record now or stronger evidence with no record.

architect_raw_payload.climax: Deniz uses the five-reading table, the re-leveling record, and the stated limits under closing-tide pressure. In report_now, Kural accepts a provisional entry. In fresh_setup_retest, the new setup reproduces a similar offset but the window closes before review.
architect_raw_payload.local_payoff: Each branch resolves one local uncertainty. In report_now, Kural accepts a provisional entry with single-setup limits, but setup-dependence stays open. In fresh_setup_retest, setup-dependence is answered in favor of a real offset, but only a field note exists. Recurrence, cause, other beacons, and the wider Saga mechanism remain open in both.
architect_raw_payload.forward_hook: Is this one beacon's quirk, or the first visible sign that the old markers and the official charts disagree across the network?

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated tide-linked offset observation at Beacon Ridge, with its limits stated.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Delivered prose shows the five-reading series and the branch result.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Kural's view of Deniz's method becomes cautious respect.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Committed only if Kural accepts the report or credits the retest rigor in prose.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated logbook entry usable as a reference.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only in report_now, with Kural's provisional acceptance shown.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Harbor navigators begin talking about 'the ridge beacon problem'.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if prose shows the story spreading.

completion_evidence: Five timestamped, tide-paired readings under one unchanged setup are shown.
Kural accepts a dated provisional entry with explicit single-setup limits (report_now only).
Deniz states a working hypothesis that stops short of claiming recurrence, cause, or other beacons.
Not earned in fresh_setup_retest, where only a field note exists.

anti_repetition_signature.core_problem_shape: Auditable evidence-building against a closing measurement window
anti_repetition_signature.primary_activity: Repeated timed instrument readings and methodology defense
anti_repetition_signature.main_location_pattern: Single-site ridge with harbor records as copied context
anti_repetition_signature.climax_shape: Bounded evidence presentation versus stronger unrecorded retest
anti_repetition_signature.distinct_from_recent_episodes_because: There are no prior episodes; this is the Saga entry.

writer_rules: Do not add scenes at Meridian Harbor.
Do not choose the branch for Deniz; dramatize the deliberation, then execute only the chosen branch's fixed result.
Do not invent the retest result or Kural's verdict beyond the branch definitions.
State the five readings with times, intervals, and tide states.
Do not claim recurrence, physical cause, other beacons, or a wider mechanism.
Keep prose to 1600-2500 words with clear language.

dimensions.name: AGE_MATURITY
dimensions.reason: The premise supports age-12 readers through competing hypotheses, evidence standards, mentorship pressure, and a consequential strategic choice.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_COHERENCE
dimensions.reason: The sequence is causally linked from anomaly to controlled testing to pattern interpretation and an evidence-based decision. The fresh-setup branch's evidentiary conclusion is somewhat overstated.

dimensions.name: ESCALATION
dimensions.reason: Escalation changes the problem from detecting an odd reading to distinguishing tide-linked behavior from setup error under a closing window, rather than merely repeating attempts.

dimensions.name: AGENCY
dimensions.reason: Deniz generates the evidence, interprets its limits, and chooses between two materially different actions with distinct costs.

dimensions.name: REVERSAL_QUALITY
dimensions.reason: The reversal is properly bounded to a within-session tide-linked pattern on one setup, and the cited beats support the stated observed and inferred claims without leaking a wider truth.

dimensions.name: CLIMAX_PAYOFF
dimensions.reason: The report branch has a sound payoff, but the fresh-setup branch claims that one similar reading resolves setup-dependence in favor of a real offset. One new reading can weaken the setup-error hypothesis, not resolve it, so its promised climax payoff is evidentially too strong.

dimensions.name: WORLD_IMMERSION
dimensions.reason: Magnetic-stone calibration, tide gauges, copied harbor records, supervised fieldwork, and methodology-based mentorship are tightly specific to the setting.

dimensions.name: SAGA_ALIGNMENT
dimensions.reason: The episode establishes an appropriately limited first discrepancy and preserves recurrence, cause, and network implications as open questions. The conditional milestone handling is coherent.

dimensions.name: LOCAL_SATISFACTION
dimensions.reason: The report branch delivers a credible provisional record, but the retest branch promises a stronger resolution than its single fresh reading can support, making its local payoff under-justified.

dimensions.name: WRITER_EXECUTABILITY
dimensions.reason: Most logistics, branch actions, and evidence are fixed and executable, but the writer is instructed to dramatize a branch result whose evidentiary meaning is not soundly specified. The retest payoff needs correction rather than invention.

dimensions.name: REPETITION_SAFETY
dimensions.reason: There are no prior episodes, and the episode has a distinct auditable-measurement, tide-window, and report-versus-retest structure.

blocking_reasons: The fresh-setup branch overclaims what one similar reading can establish: it cannot resolve setup-dependence or prove a real offset by itself.
The fresh-setup branch's stated local payoff and evidence state must be weakened or given additional controlled evidence, while preserving the time trade-off.
Both branch outcomes must remain independently executable without requiring the writer to invent the missing evidentiary logic.
gate_raw_payload.decision_reason: The spine is strong in premise, agency, escalation, world integration, and bounded reversal logic, but the fresh-setup branch contains a blocking evidence-to-payoff error. Replan that branch so the new reading supports, rather than resolves, setup-independence, or specify a genuinely sufficient retest procedure and its time cost.

escalation_ladder: Simple leveling error is ruled out after re-leveling.
Harbor logs offer no corroboration, so Deniz must generate the evidence.
The five-reading series shows a tide-linked pattern, making random noise an unsafe dismissal.
Time allows only one of report or fresh-setup retest, and setup-dependence remains open.

reversal.prior_belief: The drift is a lone reading, probably instrument error or noise.

evidence.claim: The offset persisted after re-leveling and clamp checks.
Harbor shipping-log copies show no delays or complaints.
Five timestamped readings at fixed 20-minute intervals, each paired with a tide-gauge reading, showed the offset shrinking toward slack and growing again as the tide turned.
On this unchanged setup, the offset varies with tide state during this session.

reversal.reinterpretation: The drift behaves as a tide-linked pattern within one session rather than as scatter, so it warrants logging.
reversal.inference_ceiling: This supports only a within-session correlation on one setup. It does not establish recurrence, physical cause, other beacons, or setup-independence.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Setup-dependence, recurrence on other days, physical cause, other beacons, and any wider Saga mechanism.

decision_point.pressure: The remaining window fits either the bounded report or a fresh-setup retest, not both.

branches.option: Report the five-reading series now with explicit single-setup limits.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz presents the table, the re-leveling record, and the stated limits to Kural.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Strong within-session evidence on a single setup; setup-independence untested.
branches.cost_or_risk: Forgoes the retest, so the entry stays provisional and the alternative explanation stays open.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Kural gains cautious respect for Deniz's methodology and supervised access continues.
branches.climax_requirement: Deniz must defend the method honestly, stating what the series does not show, and answer Kural's setup-dependence challenge without overclaiming.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Kural accepts a provisional dated discrepancy entry with explicit single-setup limits; the logbook page becomes a reusable reference.

branches.option: Use the remaining window for a fresh-setup retest at the second sighting stake.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz re-sets the instrument from scratch and takes a new reading against the tide gauge.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: The fresh setup reproduces a similar offset, strengthening the setup-independent case.
branches.cost_or_risk: The tide closes before Kural can review a formal entry, so no reviewed log is completed.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Kural is impressed by the rigor but cannot log it; access continues with a request to bring the field note next session.
branches.climax_requirement: Deniz must complete the fresh setup and reading under time pressure, then accept that the window has closed with only a timestamped field note.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: The setup-dependence question is resolved in favor of a real offset, but only Deniz's timestamped field note exists, with no milestone commit.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Which trade Deniz will choose: a provisional record now or stronger evidence with no record.

episode_spine.climax: Deniz uses the five-reading table, the re-leveling record, and the stated limits under closing-tide pressure. In report_now, Kural accepts a provisional entry. In fresh_setup_retest, the new setup reproduces a similar offset but the window closes before review.
episode_spine.local_payoff: Each branch resolves one local uncertainty. In report_now, Kural accepts a provisional entry with single-setup limits, but setup-dependence stays open. In fresh_setup_retest, setup-dependence is answered in favor of a real offset, but only a field note exists. Recurrence, cause, other beacons, and the wider Saga mechanism remain open in both.
episode_spine.forward_hook: Is this one beacon's quirk, or the first visible sign that the old markers and the official charts disagree across the network?

writer_rules: Do not add scenes at Meridian Harbor.
Do not choose the branch for Deniz; dramatize the deliberation, then execute only the chosen branch's fixed result.
Do not invent the retest result or Kural's verdict beyond the branch definitions.
State the five readings with times, intervals, and tide states.
Do not claim recurrence, physical cause, other beacons, or a wider mechanism.
Keep prose to 1600-2500 words with clear language.

dimensions.name: AGE_MATURITY
dimensions.reason: The premise supports age-12 readers through competing hypotheses, evidence standards, mentorship pressure, and a consequential strategic choice.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_COHERENCE
dimensions.reason: The sequence is causally linked from anomaly to controlled testing to pattern interpretation and an evidence-based decision. The fresh-setup branch's evidentiary conclusion is somewhat overstated.

dimensions.name: ESCALATION
dimensions.reason: Escalation changes the problem from detecting an odd reading to distinguishing tide-linked behavior from setup error under a closing window, rather than merely repeating attempts.

dimensions.name: AGENCY
dimensions.reason: Deniz generates the evidence, interprets its limits, and chooses between two materially different actions with distinct costs.

dimensions.name: REVERSAL_QUALITY
dimensions.reason: The reversal is properly bounded to a within-session tide-linked pattern on one setup, and the cited beats support the stated observed and inferred claims without leaking a wider truth.

dimensions.name: CLIMAX_PAYOFF
dimensions.reason: The report branch has a sound payoff, but the fresh-setup branch claims that one similar reading resolves setup-dependence in favor of a real offset. One new reading can weaken the setup-error hypothesis, not resolve it, so its promised climax payoff is evidentially too strong.

dimensions.name: WORLD_IMMERSION
dimensions.reason: Magnetic-stone calibration, tide gauges, copied harbor records, supervised fieldwork, and methodology-based mentorship are tightly specific to the setting.

dimensions.name: SAGA_ALIGNMENT
dimensions.reason: The episode establishes an appropriately limited first discrepancy and preserves recurrence, cause, and network implications as open questions. The conditional milestone handling is coherent.

dimensions.name: LOCAL_SATISFACTION
dimensions.reason: The report branch delivers a credible provisional record, but the retest branch promises a stronger resolution than its single fresh reading can support, making its local payoff under-justified.

dimensions.name: WRITER_EXECUTABILITY
dimensions.reason: Most logistics, branch actions, and evidence are fixed and executable, but the writer is instructed to dramatize a branch result whose evidentiary meaning is not soundly specified. The retest payoff needs correction rather than invention.

dimensions.name: REPETITION_SAFETY
dimensions.reason: There are no prior episodes, and the episode has a distinct auditable-measurement, tide-window, and report-versus-retest structure.

blocking_reasons: The fresh-setup branch overclaims what one similar reading can establish: it cannot resolve setup-dependence or prove a real offset by itself.
The fresh-setup branch's stated local payoff and evidence state must be weakened or given additional controlled evidence, while preserving the time trade-off.
Both branch outcomes must remain independently executable without requiring the writer to invent the missing evidentiary logic.
gate.decision_reason: The spine is strong in premise, agency, escalation, world integration, and bounded reversal logic, but the fresh-setup branch contains a blocking evidence-to-payoff error. Replan that branch so the new reading supports, rather than resolves, setup-independence, or specify a genuinely sufficient retest procedure and its time cost.
